texts.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们对该行为出现了不同意见的分歧：我们是应该把这次冲击视为与外星文明建立更紧密的联系的跳板，或者是被认为一种警告，我们必须确保舰队准备万全，以免为时已晚。
texts.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a springboard to boost efforts to establish closer ties with alien civilizations, or whether it should be taken as a warning and that we must make sure our fleet is in good order now, before it is too late.

texts.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。虽然有些人担心这些外星人可能不像我们这么友好，但人们已经达成共识，对于这种情况，我们应该加倍努力与星系其他文明建立更紧密的联系。
texts.en: In what comes as a welcome surprise to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Although some worry that these aliens may not be as welcoming as we are, consensus has already been established that we should respond to this occurrence by redoubling our efforts to establish closer ties with the other civilizations of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。人们已经达成广泛共识，我们应该对这种入侵做出回应，以确保我们的舰队准备万全且为时未晚。
texts.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Widespread consensus has emerged that we should respond to this trespass by making sure our fleet is in good order with all haste, before it is too late.

texts.zh: 令人不安的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们不确定该如何应对此事：我们应当选择继续专注于与外星文明和平友好地共存，还是应该把这看做一种警醒并提高我们的舰队规模，以防万一可能的威胁呢？
texts.en: In a disturbing development, it seems that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. We are unsure how to respond to this: should we choose to redouble our focus on peaceful and friendly coexistence with alien civilizations, or should we treat this as a warning and increase the size of our navy in case future hostilities are necessary?

texts.zh: 令人不安的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]。我们应当扩充我们的舰队以保证这帮外星人不会有什么非分之想。
texts.en: In a disturbing development, it seems that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned [This.Owner.Capital.GetName]. We should increase the size of our navy so that we may set about putting these aliens in their place.
